name: PHPStan setup
description: Installs PHPStan with rtCamp's shared baseline (includes `vendor/rtcamp/wp-phpstan/phpstan.neon.dist` alongside szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress) and adds composer analyse scripts.

inputs.description: Main plugin file, analysed with the rest of the project. Found by its Plugin Name header; left out for a theme.
A theme's `functions.php`, analysed when the project has it.
`uninstall.php`, analysed when the project has it.
`framework/`, analysed when the project has it.
`inc/`, analysed when the project has it.
`includes/`, analysed when the project has it.
A theme's `patterns/`, analysed when the project has it.
`src/`, analysed when the project has it.
A theme's `template-parts/`, analysed when the project has it.
`templates/`, analysed when the project has it.
